body:
# Outlined Tools and Armor

A clean, bold outline style applied to every tool, weapon and armor piece in Minecraft — making your gear pop with sharp, comic-style edges.

## ✨ Features

- **Bold black outlines** on every tool, weapon, and armor texture for a crisp, comic/sticker-style look
- **Full material coverage**: Wood, Stone, Iron, Golden, Diamond, Netherite, Copper, and Chainmail
- **Every gear slot included**: Swords, Pickaxes, Axes, Shovels, Hoes, Spears, Helmets, Chestplates, Leggings, Boots
- **Extra items reworked too**: Horse Armor, Nautilus Armor, Ingots, Nuggets, Raw Materials, Smithing Templates, and more
- Designed to make items instantly **easier to recognize** in your inventory and hotbar

## 🧰 What's Included

| Category | Items |
|---|---|
| Tools | Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, Hoe |
| Weapons | Sword, Spear |
| Armor | Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots |
| Materials | Ingots, Nuggets, Raw Ores |
| Extras | Horse Armor, Nautilus Armor, Golden Apple, Golden Carrot, Netherite Upgrade Template |

Covers all standard materials: **Wood • Stone • Iron • Gold • Diamond • Netherite • Copper • Chainmail**

## 📝 Notes

This pack focuses purely on item textures — no blocks, entities, or UI changes — so it's lightweight and easy to combine with other resource packs.
